name: align_task_with_objective
description: Link one existing Sunsama task to one of the user's Sunsama weekly objectives, both identified by ID. WRITE - this changes how the user's week is organised in Sunsama. Use it only when the user asked to tie that specific task to that specific objective; do not infer links from task titles or align tasks in bulk. It is not for tasks in any other app (Asana, Todoist, Jira, a calendar and so on).
